content: Based on the previous construction method, we add weak supervised signals to the context-gloss pairs (see the highlighted part in Table TABREF1). The signal in the gloss sentence aims to point out the target word, and the signal in the context sentence aims to emphasize the target word considering the situation that a target word may occur more than one time in the same sentence.
